7. Estate Freeze: An estate freeze can help reduce the value of the estate for inheritance tax purposes by transferring ownership of the business to the next generation.
8. Family Limited Partnerships: Family limited partnerships can help reduce inheritance tax by transferring ownership of assets to the next generation while maintaining control and management.
